data.one_liner: Next-generation ORM for Dart & Flutter using Prisma Engine.
data.what_it_does: Prisma Client Dart is an auto-generated type-safe ORM that supports databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB. It uses the Prisma Engine as a data access layer and offers APIs consistent with Prisma Client JS/TS.
use_when: You want to use Prisma workflows and schemas with Dart and Flutter apps.
You need a type-safe database client with support for migrations and complex relations.
avoid_when: You are looking for actively maintained updates, as development has been temporarily suspended until after June 2025.
You prefer a lightweight SQLite-only wrapper without external query engine binaries.
strengths: Type-safe queries, filtering, sorting, and relations.
Supports multiple relational databases and MongoDB.
Consistent API with Prisma Client JS/TS.
weaknesses: Development is currently suspended until after June 2025 due to Prisma's architectural changes.
Depends on external Prisma engines for data access.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package dependency and configuring a Prisma schema and query engine.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: A robust, reactive SQLite database library for Dart and Flutter with heavy query type safety and active maintenance.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: A straightforward, lightweight SQLite plugin for Flutter if you only need local SQLite access.
